headline: Discussed repairs at Baldwin, Curtis, and Jenks, including roofs, HVAC, drainage, and paving; approved 2027 schedule.
summary: The meeting covered repair and construction updates at Baldwin, Curtis, and Jenks. Topics included HVAC, door motors, drainage, roofing, and the paving project. Members unanimously approved the 2027 schedule and the July 27, 2026 minutes.

decision_evidence.quote: A. July 27, 2026 Motion to approve: Hersh Cristino Second: Mark Andrade Yea: all Motion carries unanimously.

A. 2027 Facilities Subcommittee Schedule Matthew Wildenhain gave clerk Emily Lotter credit for getting the schedule together. Motion to approve: Mark Andrade Second: Hersh Cristino Yea: all Motion carries unanimously.
